name: Nochiseyama Castle
text: Nochiseyama Castle (後瀬山城, Nochiseyama-jō) was a Sengoku period yamashiro-style Japanese castle located in what is now part of the city of Obama, Fukui Prefecture in the Hokuriku region of Honshu, Japan. The ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 1997.

depictions.name: Nochiseyama Castle
depictions.text: Nochiseyama Castle (後瀬山城) is a castle located in Obama, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated in the Wakasa province. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historical Site as of 1997.
